scientific_integrity: Established coefficientwise convolution and Young constant are attributed to source; the new claim is the explicit necessary-and-sufficient equality classification. Finite diagnostics are not substituted for analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Only finite nonzero Fourier polynomials and the L2 x L2 to Linfty Young endpoint on 2D quantum tori; no infinite-support classification, quantitative near-extremizer stability, or independent priority certification.
title: Exact endpoint Young extremizers on two-dimensional quantum tori
